attributes.Procedure: To dimension fire protection for laterally braced beams or ties for a given fire resistance, use Table D.1. Calculate the oversizing coefficient (µfi) as defined in SI 6. Determine the shape factor (Am/V), where Am is the exposed surface area per unit length (unprotected element or inner face of protection) considering only the exposed contour in the fire sector, and V is the steel element volume per unit length. For constant cross-section elements, Am/V equals the ratio of exposed perimeter to cross-sectional area. Calculate the coating insulation coefficient (d/λp) as the average of exposed faces, where d is coating thickness in meters and λp is effective thermal conductivity of the coating in W/mK for the total fire resistance time. For stone, ceramic, concrete, mortar, and gypsum materials, λp at 20 ºC can be used.
